Unexplained and Unexplored takes you into mysterious places and strange occurrences that challenge everything we know. As investigators uncover hidden clues and unexpected evidence, each discovery raises more questions than answers. What secrets are waiting to be revealed?
Watch Unexplained and Unexplored, Season 1, Episodes 3, 7, 1, 6, 8, 2 and 4, on Discovery Channel India.
